sloka: यावन्न राज्ये राज्यार्ह: पितृपैतामहे स्थित:।अभिषेकजलक्लिन्नो न मे शान्तिर्भविष्ऺयति ॥ २.९८.९॥
transliteration: yāvanna rājye rājyārha: pitṛpaitāmahe sthita:।abhiṣekajalaklinno na me śāntirbhaviṣऺyati ॥ 2.98.9॥

translations.english: I shall not attain peace until Rama, who is worthy of this kingdom, is sprinkled with the holy water of coronation and assumes the ancestral kingdom.
